summary: Crystal Veins form the outer lattice of Underfoot, carrying Brell’s divine resonance through the plane. These conduits pulse with radiant energy, guarded by crystal constructs and root‑born entities.
history: Crystal Veins were the first extensions of the Crystal Root lattice.
Resonance chambers formed where divine energy pooled.
Root‑born entities emerged to protect the crystal network.
The Resonance Core developed sentience as the lattice expanded.
